[id 230] 12 cars × $20,000 = $240,000. Tax is 10% = $24,000. Registration is 12 × $1,000 = $12,000. Total = $240,000 + $24,000 + $12,000 = $276,000.

[id 231] Robert collects 20 shells, so Kylie collects 20 + 5 = 25 on Monday. On Tuesday she collects 2 × 25 = 50 shells.

[id 232] Bugs are half the ants: 50 ÷ 2 = 25. Total insects = 50 + 25 = 75.

[id 233] One-third of 36 is 12, and another one-third is 12. 36 − 12 − 12 = 12 penguins remain.

[id 234] Steve eats 6 per day, so he needs 6 × 7 = 42 tomatoes per week. Each vine yields 3 per week, so 42 ÷ 3 = 14 vines. (The girlfriend’s consumption is extra information.)

[id 235] 20 friends × 4 slices = 80 slices needed. 80 ÷ 8 slices per pizza = 10 pizzas.

[id 236] 25 empty pens make 25 ÷ 5 = 5 new pens. Those 5 empty pens make 5 ÷ 5 = 1 more pen. Total = 25 + 5 + 1 = 31 pens.

[id 237] $20 + $10 = $30. Tripled: $30 × 3 = $90.

[id 238] Jessa is 20. Joan is 20 + 5 = 25. Mary is 25 − 2 = 23. Sum = 20 + 25 + 23 = 68.

[id 239] Exit A: 30% of 1000 = 300. Remaining: 700. Exit B: 3/5 of 700 = 420. Remaining for Exit C: 700 − 420 = 280.
